verdict.rationale: First-party evidence documents an `ollama launch` command that sets up and runs Claude Code, OpenCode and Codex against local or cloud models with no environment variables or config files [ollama-docs-15]. The homepage says the same: "Launch Claude Code, Codex, and more with one command" [ollama-docs-2]. Supporting pieces are an Anthropic Messages API compatibility layer [ollama-docs-13] and listed integrations with Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex and Copilot [ollama-gh-1]. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that `ollama launch` works as claimed, and in-depth reference docs on the command (supported agent list, flags, model selection behavior).
